findings.fix: Check the error and RowsAffected; abort or log-and-compensate on failure.

review.title: SQL appears dynamically built
review.ev: internal/server/order_notifications.go:37  _ = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE thread_id=$1 AND body LIKE $2`, threadID, body[:40]+"%").Scan(&n)
review.impact: If any operand is user-controlled this is SQL injection.
review.fix: Use parameterised queries ($1…) exclusively; never interpolate values.

review.title: Network not internal: app
review.ev:
image: onionshop-app:local
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    <<: *default-hardening
    user: "1000:101"
    environment:
      - ONIONSHOP_UNIX=/run/onionshop/app.sock
review.impact: Container egress bypasses default-deny expectations.
review.fix: Set internal: true, or document why (nginx edge needs a gateway for published ports).
